fieldNotes.truckGate: Gatehouse on a median island splits the central truck court into an in-lane and out-lane at a pinch-point between landscaped islands and perimeter chain-link fence (z20 sat 40.60855,-75.32475). Court is fully fenced; entry from Commerce Center Blvd at the south.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small 1-2-vehicle-footprint booth sitting on the median island mid-court, windows on multiple sides, vehicle parked at it. Listing brochure also cites a guard house with restroom on the parcel.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide central truck court and double-wide approach lanes around the median booth give unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved court between the gatehouse and the dock faces holds a deep queue of trucks inside the fence before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Central court runs ~300m, easily holds 3+ trucks staging between gate and docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Building 1B listing = 78 dock-high doors; satellite shows dense dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in on the west (court) face and a second bank on the east face. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large unpaved gravel drop yard south of the perimeter road packed with 60-80 parked trailers without tractors (sat 40.6066,-75.3236). Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated gravel trailer-storage lot on the south parcel, separate from active court staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on both the west (central court) and east faces of the building, but cannot confirm they run as physically separate ship vs receive clusters from overhead; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Majestic Bethlehem Center is an edge-of-town big-box industrial park on the former Bethlehem Steel land, bordered by ravine/woodland and rail yards; setting reads Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A multi-track rail yard sits south of the property but it is separated by a ravine and tree line and is regional/legacy infrastructure, not a private spur into the NFI docks. False.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Audited the NFI 3051 / Majestic Bldg 1B leased parcel as one building; the park has several adjacent big-box DCs but they are separate addresses.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Listing cites ~24-acre lot for Bldg 1B; perimeter ring drawn to that leased parcel including the south gravel drop yard.
